subject.title: fix #91171: [Bug]: Sub-agent model routing ignores model parameter, silently falls back to deepseek

question: Should trusted explicit direct and plugin sub-agent model overrides carry `allowModelOverride` onto the effective scoped in-process gateway client, with admin scope used for the out-of-process direct launch?
rationale: The implementation and proof support the fix, but the permanent provider/model authorization contract is a maintainer-owned security and routing boundary.

options.title: Accept Effective-Client Authorization
options.body: Keep the current design so trusted override authority reaches whichever scoped or synthetic client the gateway actually dispatches.

options.title: Create Caller-Specific Capabilities
options.body: Split direct and plugin override markers if maintainers want distinct trust contracts despite their shared downstream invariant.

recommendation.title: Accept Effective-Client Authorization
recommendation.body: Keep the current design so trusted override authority reaches whichever scoped or synthetic client the gateway actually dispatches.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the plugin sub-agent override authorization behavior whose effective-client semantics this PR extends.
